fig_pipeline_architecture: Overview of the topic-bottleneck query reformulation pipeline. The six-step process extracts a topic distribution from a sensitive (S2) question, generates generic S0 text, optionally applies vocabulary exclusion, generates and selects proxy questions, sends only S0 content to the cloud LLM, and synthesizes the final answer locally. Dashed red arrows indicate paths where the S2 question is used only locally. The trust boundary separates the local environment (green) from the cloud (blue).
fig_recovery_rate_comparison: Specific value recovery rates for our topic-bottleneck pipeline compared with DP-sanitized text attacked by various LLMs (Pang et al., 2024). Our approach achieves 2.3\% recovery (0\% with vocabulary exclusion), compared to 72--94\% for differential privacy methods. The dashed red line indicates the 10\% acceptable recovery threshold.
fig_task_type_heatmap: Performance metrics across four task types (n=12 each). Framework/reasoning, compliance, and procedural tasks achieve zero specific value recovery with strong BERTScore F1 (0.886--0.890). Entity-specific tasks show the expected quality-privacy trade-off with higher gold span overlap (0.65) and non-zero recovery (9.2\%). The dashed boundary highlights the operating envelope limit.
fig_quality_privacy_scatter: Quality-privacy trade-off across methods. The x-axis shows specific value recovery rate (lower is better for privacy) and the y-axis shows BERTScore F1 (higher is better for quality). Our topic-bottleneck approach occupies the ideal region (low recovery, high quality), while DP methods cluster in the high-recovery region. The green-shaded area marks the target zone below 10\% recovery.
